requirements.acceptance: Internal users sign in with their AD account, no registration; role comes from the user record.
requirements.note: Prototype uses a demo email + password + OTP. Real AD/SSO needs the backend and Azure AD.

requirements.acceptance: Ends the session, returns to the login page and clears cached data.
requirements.note: Sign-out ends the session and returns to login; progress and admin data cached in the browser are not cleared.

requirements.acceptance: Concurrent login limited to a single session.
requirements.note: Needs server-side session tracking.

requirements.acceptance: Name, role/designation, team, department, email and region; ask for missing location, team and department after login.
requirements.note: First sign-in from an invite asks for missing profile details (designation, organization, region, phone) before anything else; admins see what is still missing.

requirements.acceptance: Invite one by one or upload a list; also during a training. Bulk invite can create and name a group.
requirements.note: Admin invites temporary users by email with access dates and trainings; an invite link is generated and copied. Sending the email is simulated until email (Y05).

requirements.acceptance: Start and expiry dates; start can't be in the past; set at invite, during or after training; can be extended after training ends.
Invite email contains a login link (stories) or one-time credentials (URS).
requirements.note: Invite link opens a sign-in for that person, followed by OTP and profile setup; expired or revoked invites are refused with a clear message.

requirements.acceptance: Forgot-password flow for temporary users.
requirements.note: Sign-in uses OTP with resend and expiry; invited users never set a password (D10). Real SMS/email delivery needs the backend.

requirements.requirement: Optional MFA for admins and trainers
requirements.acceptance: OTP may be enabled for Admin and Trainer roles.
requirements.note: The demo OTP step applies to everyone; needs a per-role setting and real SMS/email delivery.

requirements.requirement: Keep access to records after training
requirements.acceptance: Access lasts a pre-set time after the training ends, tied to the validity period.
requirements.note: Temporary trainees keep read access to their records and certificates for 30 days after the training by default (editable end date); access ends automatically afterwards.

requirements.acceptance: Deactivate permanent users; revoke temporary users.
requirements.note: Admins can deactivate users (Users page) and revoke temporary access; a revoked user is signed out on their next action and sees why.

requirements.requirement: Restrict permanent access to company email domains
requirements.acceptance: For example safaricom.et.

requirements.requirement: Several roles per user, highest role wins
requirements.acceptance: A user may hold multiple roles; permissions follow the highest role.
requirements.note: Still one role per demo account (learner, admin or requester); waiting on the role matrix (D8).

requirements.requirement: Turn a user into a Requester
requirements.acceptance: Toggle on the user; temporary users can't be requesters; only admins grant or revoke.
requirements.note: Users page: "Make requester" / "Remove requester", admin only, disabled for temporary users; Requesters tab and badge.

requirements.acceptance: Sees assigned materials only; no edit rights or trainee tracking.
Add users one by one or in bulk; groups appear in the request form's Target Audience.
requirements.note: Create/edit groups, add one by one, "Add all" matching a search, or paste a list of emails; groups appear as Target Audience in the request form.

requirements.acceptance: Training type, category/sub-category (multi-select with 'Other'), target audience, delivery method, location if physical, preferred date and time, participant emails (manual and bulk), objectives, optional description and file upload; validated before submit.
requirements.note: Requester form has every field, including categories and optional sub-categories from the managed list, with inline validation. Attachments keep name and size only.

requirements.requirement: Save a request as a draft
requirements.acceptance: Drafts expire after 24 hours; reopening restores every field.
requirements.note: Save draft from the form; drafts list shows time left and is purged after 24 hours; reopening restores every field.

requirements.acceptance: Names and emails for temporary trainees; size limits per file type.
requirements.note: Add one by one, paste a list, or upload CSV/TXT (name,email). Bad lines are reported; names fill in from the directory; temporary trainees must have a name. Excel files need saving as CSV.

requirements.acceptance: Pending / Approved / Rejected at each step, rejection reason visible; dashboard and email updates.
requirements.note: Requester dashboard with status counts, filter tabs, a timeline per request (Submitted → Under review → Approved/Rejected → Scheduled), rejection reason and an Updates feed. Email copies wait for Y05.

requirements.requirement: Get a join link after approval
requirements.acceptance: Link works only for portal users in the same team or organisation.
requirements.note: Join link generated on approval, shown with a copy button to the requester and admin. Restricting it to same-team portal users needs the backend.

requirements.acceptance: Same team, training type and time; a team can have several requesters.
requirements.note: Same team + training type + date is flagged while filling in, asked about on submit (warn, D13 default) and badged in the admin queue.

requirements.acceptance: Store requester ID and timestamps; notify the admin / assigned trainer.
requirements.note: Requester ID, submit time and every decision are stored in request history and the audit log; the new request appears in the admin queue. Email notification waits for Y05.

requirements.acceptance: Approve assigns a trainer; reject needs a reason from a list plus an optional comment.
requirements.note: Approve assigns a trainer and opens scheduling pre-filled; reject needs a reason from a list, plus a comment when the reason is "Other".

requirements.acceptance: Admin can make trainers approvers; trainers can't approve or assign themselves.
requirements.note: Admin can flag trainers as approvers (Approver badge). The self-approval rule applies once trainers can sign in.

requirements.requirement: Schedule a session without a request
requirements.acceptance: Title, category/sub-category, description, trainer, level, journey, pre/post assessments, delivery method, once or recurring, date and time, participant emails.
requirements.note: Schedule form: title, category/sub-category, description, type, level, journey, trainer, optional pre/post assessments, Online (Teams meeting created) or Physical with location, once or recurring, date/time, groups and participant emails, with live conflict warnings.

requirements.acceptance: Date and time, duration, training type, delivery type, location if physical.
requirements.note: Approving a request opens the scheduling form pre-filled (title, type, trainer, date, time, location, known participants) and links the new training back to the request. No trainer login yet.

requirements.acceptance: Daily, weekly or monthly; custom patterns such as every Friday at 3 PM.
requirements.note: Daily, weekly (pick weekdays, e.g. every Tue+Thu) or monthly, every N, until a date; creates one session per date in a series (max 52), with a plain-language summary and date preview.

requirements.requirement: Reschedule or cancel with a reason
requirements.acceptance: Reason from a dropdown or custom; history kept; everyone affected is notified.
requirements.note: Reschedule and cancel need a reason (dropdown or custom), apply to one session or "this and following" in a series, and are kept in Schedule history plus the audit log. Notifications are simulated until email (Y05).

requirements.acceptance: Filters for trainer, team, training type and date; colours for Confirmed / Pending / Cancelled.
requirements.note: Admin Calendar: month and agenda views; filters for trainer, team and training type; Confirmed / Pending (approved but unscheduled requests) / Completed / Cancelled colours; conflict markers; day panel.

requirements.acceptance: Trainer double-booking and trainees with overlapping sessions.
requirements.note: Trainer double-bookings and trainees in overlapping sessions are detected in the schedule form, reschedule, change-trainer and invite dialogs, on the training page, the trainings list and the calendar.

requirements.requirement: Send invites before or during a training
requirements.acceptance: Internal teams by group email, external by email, or a few people manually; copy and share the invite link.
requirements.note: Invite people or whole groups (busy trainees flagged), optional invitation email with a note, and "Copy invite link" on each session. Emails are simulated until Y05.

requirements.acceptance: Delegate to another trainer with a reason.
requirements.note: Change trainer with a required reason, for one session or the rest of the series; conflicts for the new trainer are shown and the change is kept in history.

requirements.acceptance: Individual / team schedule view with edit and filter.
Trainees see My Trainings, trainers their assigned sessions, admins everything; no cross-team access.
requirements.note: Learners see their own trainings, trainers only the sessions they conduct, admins everything; enforced in the app only until there is a backend.

requirements.requirement: Microsoft Teams join and attendance sync
requirements.note: Built on request: Join Live Training, Graph-shaped attendance with simulated data and Present / Late / Incomplete / Absent rules.

requirements.acceptance: Documents (PDF, DOCX, PPT) with minimum viewing time, images, links (YouTube, SharePoint, Google, external LMS), small videos. Attributes: level, downloadable per group, description, duration, skills, thumbnail.
requirements.note: Materials store title, type, minutes, description, level, skills, thumbnail, per-group visibility and download toggles, minimum viewing time and URL; file upload itself is simulated.

requirements.acceptance: Tagged trainers can view and/or edit.
requirements.note: Trainers sign in to a trainer portal; they can edit and replace materials they are tagged on (or create), and other materials are view-only.

requirements.acceptance: Re-upload / override (documents only) and notify trainees who have access.
requirements.note: Edit, delete and Replace file (documents/presentations) work; replacing bumps the version, appends to the version history and toasts how many trainees with access were notified.

requirements.acceptance: Sequential learning is enforced.
requirements.note: Journey builder (add, reorder, delete modules, attach materials); modules unlock in order in the learner view — each locks until the previous one is completed.

requirements.acceptance: Completion status and assigned assessments; start/end dates for the whole journey; each module unlocks after the previous one.
requirements.note: Journey start/end dates, per-module assigned assessment and unlock order are configurable; completion status is tracked per module and enforced in the learner view.

requirements.acceptance: No visibility outside the assigned group.
requirements.note: Materials carry per-group visibility and download groups; learners see a Download button only when their group is allowed, otherwise the deck is view-only in the portal.

requirements.acceptance: Title and optional description; edit existing ones. URS lists Consumer, Enterprise, Saving & Credit, Agent/Merchant, IMT.
requirements.note: Categories page: create, rename and describe categories; add, rename and remove sub-categories; in-use items can’t be deleted. Used by the schedule form and the request form (sub-categories optional).

requirements.acceptance: YouTube / SharePoint embeds, streaming only.
requirements.note: Video materials take a YouTube, Vimeo or SharePoint / Stream link (or an .mp4) and play embedded, stream-only, with a viewer watermark; the editor shows how a pasted link will play.

requirements.acceptance: View count, watch time, completion; archive older videos after X months.
Most accessed files, popular content per skill, unused content for clean-up.
requirements.note: Content tab in Reports shows views and downloads per material (seeded counters); real tracking needs the backend.

requirements.acceptance: All sessions the trainee is assigned to.
requirements.note: Trainings page with All / Active / Upcoming / Completed, calendar and detail pages.

requirements.acceptance: Documents can be marked complete after a minimum time; videos complete automatically; finishing triggers feedback.
requirements.note: Course player: lessons unlock in order; readings complete after a minimum reading time, videos complete when watched to the end; the last finished lesson can be undone.

requirements.acceptance: Upcoming sessions (calendar), completed training, scores and pass/fail, feedback status, certificates.
requirements.note: Trainings dashboard plus a course player with an outline (sections, items, locks, progress), next-step hints and "Go to next item" navigation.

requirements.acceptance: Shown at session end or when the trainer marks it complete; required before the session is Completed.
requirements.note: Feedback opens automatically once modules are done and the assessment is passed; completion (and the certificate) requires it.

requirements.acceptance: Stores the session, user ID (unless anonymous) and timestamp.
requirements.note: Learner form: four 5-point Likert statements, Yes/No recommend, optional comment and an anonymous toggle; stores training, user and timestamp.

requirements.acceptance: Question bank, custom session questions, templates per training type; 5-point Likert, Yes/No, open comments.
requirements.note: Feedback form editor: 5-point scale, Yes/No and open questions, reorder, a feedback question bank by category, and forms assigned as templates per training type (new sessions pick theirs automatically).

requirements.acceptance: Email when a score below 2.5 is submitted.
requirements.note: An alert is raised when a feedback response averages below the threshold (default 2.5, editable) and shown in the admin bell with “email queued to the training manager”. Sending email needs the backend (Y05).

requirements.acceptance: Average by question/category, session and trainer comparison, response rate, trends; filters for date, team, trainer, type, region.
requirements.note: Feedback analytics: average by question, trainer comparison, session comparison with response rate and recommend %, monthly trend, low scores; all report filters apply.

requirements.acceptance: QR code refreshing every 10 seconds, unique link, manual marking, manual input when offline.
requirements.note: Check-in panel: rotating QR (refreshes every 10s) with countdown, unique shareable link, manual marking (comment required) and offline participant-list import; Present/Late by the late window.

requirements.requirement: Check in by QR or link
requirements.acceptance: Captures timestamp, name, designation, team, email, region and attendance start–end time.
requirements.note: 'Check in' / 'Join Live Training' records the timestamp and method (Teams or manual); profile fields come from the user record.

requirements.requirement: Late window and Present / Late / Absent
requirements.acceptance: Allowed window before a check-in counts as late (e.g. 15 minutes).
requirements.note: Late window (default 15 min, editable in Settings) applies to every check-in; Present/Late is shown to learners and in reports. Repeat check-ins for long sessions not built.

requirements.acceptance: Manual entries need a comment and trainer approval; no double entries per trainee and session.
requirements.note: Manual check-ins require a comment and start unverified; the admin verifies them from the roster; one entry per trainee per session.

requirements.acceptance: Reminder X minutes after a missed check-in; re-check for multi-hour or multi-day training.
requirements.note: 'Remind N' button for not-yet-checked-in trainees (simulated toast with a reminder history); no timed reminders or re-check-in.

requirements.acceptance: Flag the training manager when a group falls below the threshold.
requirements.note: An alert is raised when a team’s attendance for a session falls below the threshold (default 60%, editable) and shown in the admin bell; email delivery is simulated until Y05.

requirements.acceptance: Filters for date, team, trainer, region, training type; Excel and PDF; by date, training or user.
requirements.note: Attendance report across trainings by training, by trainee and by date with monthly trend; all filters; Excel, CSV and PDF export.

requirements.acceptance: Set assessments as mandatory for selected courses; configure pre and post per session.
requirements.note: Assessments carry a Mandatory flag; pre/post assessments attach per training and per journey module.

requirements.requirement: Pass mark, deadline, time limit, attempts
requirements.acceptance: Minimum score, deadline, time limit and number of retakes.
requirements.note: Pass mark, deadline, time limit (whole test or per question) and max attempts are configured per assessment and enforced in the learner quiz.

requirements.acceptance: MCQs graded automatically; open answers graded by the trainer.
requirements.note: MCQ auto-graded; descriptive and file-upload questions are graded by trainers with a score and comment on the Submissions page.

requirements.acceptance: Shuffle per trainee, lock after deadline, timer per test or question, question weights, Pass/Fail or % scale, scoring notes.
requirements.note: Shuffle, lock-after-deadline, timer scope, per-question weights, score or pass/fail grading and a topic field.
Question bank tab grouped by product category with add/delete; 'Add from bank' copies questions into an assessment.
Clone copies an assessment and tags the copy with its template (templateOf) so results stay traceable to the original.

requirements.acceptance: Time allowed, number of questions, retakes.
requirements.note: Rules screen shows question count, time limit, attempts, pass mark and a shuffle notice before the learner starts.

requirements.acceptance: Score, pass/fail, trainer comments; every attempt stored with time taken.
requirements.note: Score, pass/fail and trainer comments shown; every attempt stored with start/submit timestamps on the Submissions page.

requirements.acceptance: Completion / submissions, average score, failure trends by topic; by session, trainee or overall.
requirements.note: Assessments report: attempts, average, pass rate and needs-grading per assessment, failed attempts by month and failure rate by topic, with attempt-level export.

requirements.acceptance: Attendance Present or Late, feedback completed, assessment score met.
requirements.note: Certificate requires Present/Late check-in + passed assessment + feedback; the Certificates page lists exactly what is missing per training.

requirements.requirement: Issue automatically, with a manual fallback
requirements.acceptance: Trainers issue only for sessions they conduct.
requirements.note: Automatic issuing for eligible trainees plus manual issue with a required reason (audit-logged) and reissue; trainers can issue only for sessions they conduct.

requirements.acceptance: Branded templates, assigned per training type or audience; only admins manage them.
requirements.note: Templates can be assigned to training types (one template per type, others use the default); issuing picks the template by type.

requirements.acceptance: View permission only.
requirements.note: Each admin training page lists its issued certificates (view only) with method and date; issuing happens in the tracker.

requirements.acceptance: Name, training type, issue date and official stamp.
requirements.note: Certificate page with seal; print / save as PDF.

requirements.acceptance: Eligible trainees, filters, download and reissue, sessions not yet triggered, drill-down, export.
requirements.note: Certification tracker: eligible / issued / pending per session, drill-down per trainee with attendance, feedback and score, sessions where issuing has not run, issue, reissue, download (print) and export.

requirements.acceptance: Participation, assessment performance, feedback, certificates, request status, trainer analytics, content engagement, plus general trends.
requirements.note: Reports hub with tabs: overview and trends, attendance, assessments, feedback, certificates, requests, trainer analytics and content engagement.

requirements.acceptance: Date range, training type, team/region, trainer, status, delivery mode.
requirements.note: Shared filters on every report: date range, training type, team, region, trainer, status and delivery mode; kept in the URL so a filtered report can be shared.

requirements.requirement: Export to Excel, CSV and PDF
requirements.acceptance: Anonymisation toggle for trainee-level exports.
requirements.note: Every report exports to Excel (.xlsx, one sheet per table), CSV and PDF (print layout without the app chrome); trainee-level exports can be anonymised.

requirements.acceptance: Own sessions only: calendar and pending requests, attendance %, feedback average (per session and 30 days), assessment results, content views and downloads.
requirements.note: Trainer portal dashboard: upcoming sessions, answers to grade, requests assigned to them, attendance and feedback per session and for the last 30 days, pass rate and content views; all data limited to their own sessions.

requirements.acceptance: Requested sessions and attendance of their teams.
requirements.note: Requesters get a Team reports page: sessions they requested and their team’s Present / Late / Absent per session and per trainee, with Excel/CSV/PDF export.

requirements.acceptance: Click a metric for session/user data; custom templates (HR, Finance); daily/weekly emails.
Sessions under 70% attendance, trainees missing 3+ sessions, feedback average under 2.5.
Send materials straight to groups for self-paced reading, with an optional due date and acknowledgement.
requirements.note: Materials → Assign to groups (due date, optional “I have read and understood”). Admin Assignments page shows opened / acknowledged / overdue per person, reminders and CSV export. Learners see it in Up next, the Assigned tab and the bell.

requirements.acceptance: Fix a wrong email without creating a new invitation.
requirements.note: Edit invite checks the email is valid, external and unused; changing it issues a new sign-in link (old one stops working) and can resend it. Old and new values go to the audit log.

requirements.requirement: Replace a file without re-uploading the material
requirements.acceptance: Keep the material and its links; only the file changes.
requirements.note: Replace file uses a file picker, stores name and size, bumps the version and keeps a version history; journey, training and group links stay. File contents aren't stored in the prototype.

requirements.acceptance: Admins can download files for review.
requirements.note: Download in the material menu and preview; admins always can, videos open their source. Downloads count in reports. Presentations download the bundled sample; documents a generated PDF copy.

requirements.acceptance: Without leaving the scheduling form.
requirements.note: “+ New journey” in the scheduling form opens the journey dialog and selects the new journey.

requirements.requirement: See more than five users in invitation lists
requirements.note: Invite and group lists are no longer capped at about five rows; counts and emails shown.

requirements.acceptance: A requester also sees every trainee feature.
requirements.note: Requesters get the full learner portal plus a Requests section in the same sidebar, and land on Home.

requirements.requirement: Choose any journey, in any order
requirements.acceptance: No forced sequence between journeys.
requirements.note: Journey cards at the top of Trainings filter the list; nothing is locked between journeys. Cards shrink to chips once a filter is on.

requirements.requirement: Calendar as a view of Trainings
requirements.note: Grid / list / calendar toggle on Trainings; the calendar follows the page filters. The separate Calendar tab is gone.

requirements.requirement: View user guides in the portal
requirements.note: Help & Support has searchable FAQs and three in-portal user guides; uploading guides from admin is not built yet.
Progress, certificates, favourites, read notifications and assignment status are stored per signed-in person.

requirements.acceptance: One story from request to certificate.
requirements.note: Invited people see admin-scheduled trainings (modules from the journey, quiz from the post-assessment). Check-in, module progress, scores and feedback are written back to admin attendance, grading, feedback and the certificate tracker. Videos/decks use sample files.
Download PDF saves a real A4 file; Print prints only the certificate; the QR opens a public verification page.
Learner bell (sessions, certificates, feedback, assigned reading) with preferences on the Profile page; favourites tab on Trainings.
Admin and trainer portal only; the learner portal has no dark mode yet.

requirements.requirement: Block downloads, screenshots and screen recording
requirements.note: Browsers can't reliably block screenshots; agree realistic controls (streaming only, watermarking, DRM).

requirements.requirement: Change log with before and after values
requirements.acceptance: Who made the change, the previous and new value, timestamp.
requirements.note: Audit entries keep field-level before → after values for key edits (trainings, users, materials, assessments, templates, rules, grading, manual certificates); shown in the log and exported.

requirements.requirement: Encrypt data at rest and in transit

requirements.acceptance: Only after privacy approval.
Requests, invites, reschedules, content overrides and alerts.
requirements.note: Prototype shows in-app toasts only.

requirements.acceptance: Desktop and mobile browsers.
requirements.note: Screens checked at phone width.

decisions.ask: Use 2.5 for alerts and 3.5 for a 'review' flag, or pick one.
Pick one threshold and whether it applies per group or per session.
Confirm whether a fourth entry level exists and its name.

decisions.side_a: Nothing downloadable, no screenshots or recording (TA-7.1, TE-3.2)
decisions.side_b: Downloadable toggle per group (TA-3.1, URS 2.4); trainees can view/download materials (URS 4)
decisions.ask: Agree which content may be downloaded. Screenshot blocking can't be guaranteed in a browser.

decisions.side_a: Mandatory before a session is Completed (TA-4.1, URS 5)
decisions.ask: Confirm which questions are required, and what happens if a trainee never submits.
Confirm certificates are in scope for launch, and auto vs trainer-issued.

decisions.side_a: Default 100% attendance requirement, adjustable (TE-5.1); check-in only at the start (URS 5)
decisions.side_b: Late window, e.g. 15 min (URS 2.7); repeat check-ins for multi-hour/day sessions (URS 2.7)
decisions.ask: Define how Present/Late/Absent and the % requirement combine for long sessions.

decisions.side_b: Restricted ToT trainer; trainers approve only if allowed (URS 4, URS 5)
decisions.ask: Write a permission matrix for every role and role combination.
Choose Likert or star ratings so scores are comparable.

decisions.side_a: Login link in the invite email (TE-1.2)
decisions.side_b: One-time credentials plus OTP password reset (URS 2.1)
decisions.ask: Pick one method (a magic link or OTP avoids passwords entirely).

decisions.side_a: Upload small videos, link larger ones (TA-3.1, URS 2.4)
decisions.ask: Confirm whether any video files are stored in the portal.

decisions.side_b: URS also requires contact person and number of participants (URS 2.2, 3.1, 5)
decisions.ask: Agree the final mandatory field list.

decisions.side_b: …but says the email goes to the training admin
decisions.ask: Confirm recipients: trainer, admin or both.

decisions.side_a: Trainee story 6.1 appears twice; the second is written 'As a trainer'
decisions.side_b: Trainer stories 1.4 and 3.4–3.6 say 'As a training admin'
decisions.ask: Fix numbering and roles before baselining.

decisions.side_b: Both specify QR, unique link and manual attendance
decisions.ask: Decide if Teams attendance supplements or replaces QR/link check-in.
